definitions.explanation: The act of intentionally passing over parts of a text without reading them carefully or at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{規約|きやく}→規約：14184_kiyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばしがちだ。
examples.english: People tend to skim over the terms of service.

examples.japanese: {読|よ}み{飛|と}ばし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見落|みお}とす→見落とす：04578_miotosu⟧。
examples.english: If you skim, you'll miss important information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧とき、⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧な⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When reading a long novel, I sometimes end up skipping over the boring scenes.

notes:
The noun form of the verb ⟦{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす→読み飛ばす：06850_yomitobasu⟧ (to skim; to skip while reading). Describes the action of deliberately not reading parts of a text, whether out of impatience, disinterest, or efficiency.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {読|よ}み{飛|と}ばし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do skimming; to skip parts
- {読|よ}み{飛|と}ばしがちだ: tend to skim over
- {読|よ}み{飛|と}ばし⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no skipping (instruction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{斜|なな}め{読|よ}み→斜め読み：22744_nanameyomi⟧: skimming; reading diagonally — implies scanning quickly for key points rather than skipping entirely
- ⟦{飛|と}ばし{読|よ}み→飛ばし読み：22841_tobashiyomi⟧: skip-reading — same meaning, reversed word order; less common
- ⟦{速読|そくどく}→速読：22402_sokudoku⟧: speed reading — a technique for reading quickly while maintaining comprehension
